Without --model: management only. Embedded Gufo requires an opt-in HIP build.
Text-only AR with per-sequence sampling, thinking disabled. OpenAI function tools (execution by client). Credit-driven native decode batching. RAM prefix cache is on by default; zero MiB disables it. SSD prefix persistence is opt-in; no MTP or exact-session resume.
Model execution on shared hardware requires the coordination lease.
--build-info reports the compiled provider without opening a model.
